name: Manasseh (King of Judah)
title: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah
summary: Manasseh was the son of Hezekiah and one of the longest-reigning kings of Judah. He introduced widespread idolatry, but according to Chronicles, he humbled himself before God while in captivity in Babylon and turned back toward the end of his life. His son Amon succeeded him on the throne.

keyEvents.title: Introduces Idolatry in Judah
keyEvents.description: Manasseh rebuilt the high places, erected altars to Baal, and led Judah into gross idolatry.

keyEvents.title: Humiliation and Repentance in Captivity
keyEvents.description: Taken in chains to Babylon, Manasseh humbled himself before God, was brought back to Jerusalem, and removed the foreign gods.
